_about: Tidebreak round 3: Practice in the % ring and the Esc menu's round-3 rows (the BOTS task's file; smash_r3 spec §7.3-7.4, §11.1, §14.2; RingPractice scripts/ring/ring_practice.gd, PracticePanel scripts/ui/practice_panel.gd, RingMenu, the main menu's Practice panel, MatchSetup). Every word here is shown to the player: no word from any show and none of another game's (tests/ring/test_player_words.gd). The classic ring's practice keeps its numbers and words in screens.json practice.
_rows: The Practice rows (the Esc menu's Practice panel and the main menu's): pct the % choices for 'Its %' and 'Your %' (-1: grows, as in a match; R and a fall put the % back to the row's value); ways the dummy's ways B steps in the % ring (block: its guard on the beat, today's; guard_held: its guard up again and again; guard_after: its guard right after a hit); steer its steering when thrown; speed Engine.time_scale (a fall's moment gives back Practice's speed, not 1); fresh: every move fresh (no stale moves); throw_me: R puts you off an end instead (your recovery drill).
_numbers: walk: the dummy walks side to side walk_m each way; jump: a hop every jump_every_s, a double jump every other; recover: R and every fall put it off a random open end recover_out_m out and recover_below_m under the lip, and it comes back at the match's difficulty; throw_me: you, the same way; the string counter held counter_hold_s after a string ends; the readout read readout_after_s after the hit (its steer is read at 0.1 s).

words.row_pct_line: {reset} and a fall put it back to this
words.row_throw_me_line: {reset} puts you off an end: come back
words.row_speed_line: slow it down to see it
words.row_fresh_line: on: a move used again hits as hard
words.hint: Practice  ·  a %s dummy that %s  ·  {reset}: reset  ·  {dummy}: what it does  ·  {menu}: menu
words.notes: Hop and let go at once: a low hop.

way_lines.recover: comes back from off the deck
way_lines.throw: throws at you every few seconds

menu._doc: The Esc menu's and the main menu's round-3 rows: the rule set (the ids never shown), the games, the Controls listing's line for the % ring.
menu.rules_line: lives: 3 each, into the water loses one  ·  zones: push them back through three zones
menu.rules_line_stock: 3 lives each: into the water loses one, and all three lost loses the game
menu.rules_line_stock_team: 2 lives each in a team: into the water loses one, and a side with none left loses the game
menu.rules_line_classic: push them back through three zones and off the open end into the water
menu.games_line_menu: one game, or best of 3: the first to take two
menu.format_line_1v1: one against one: you and your opponent
menu.format_line_2v2: two a side on a wider deck, 2 lives each: your team-mate and their second drawn at random
menu.format_line_4v4: four a side on the big deck, 2 lives each: your team-mates and their other three drawn at random
menu.controls_line: 1, 2, 4, 5 ready a move  ·  hold right click, let go: cast  ·  hold left click: jab  ·  E guards  ·  3 dodges  ·  Space jumps  ·  C is down
menu.controls_line_tap: 1, 2, 4, 5 ready a move  ·  right click: cast, hold for the bigger one  ·  left click: jab  ·  E guards  ·  3 dodges  ·  Space jumps  ·  C is down
